title: Ph.D. in Artificial Intelligence
subtitle: University of Verona · Verona, Italy
description: Thesis: Optimizing Industrial Operations via Foundation Models: Integrating Time-Series Predictive Maintenance and Zero-Shot Visual Quality Control. My research aims to improve industrial operations through advanced deep learning methods. I focus on predictive maintenance using time-series data and zero-shot anomaly detection for automated quality inspection. In addition, I develop efficient Foundation Model and vision-language model solutions that can run directly on embedded devices for real-world industrial applications.

title: Master's in Computer Engineering for Robotics and Smart Industries
subtitle: University of Verona · Verona, Italy · Grade: 108/110
description: Thesis: Deep Learning for Indoor Human Trajectory Prediction: A Generative Modeling Approach. My thesis presented a novel approach to human trajectory prediction in indoor environments, focusing on shoppers' movement in supermarkets. The study leveraged conditional variational autoencoders and integrated time-series data preprocessing to improve temporal continuity, resulting in a publication.

title: Bachelor's in Computer Science
subtitle: COMSATS University Islamabad · Islamabad, Pakistan · Grade: 3.54/4.0
description: Thesis: LiveVision AR: Real-Time Segmentation and Enhancement for Immersive Environments. The project utilized C# and EMGUCV for real-time image segmentation and enhancement. The system integrated real-world objects (e.g., people, animals) into 3D augmented environments by isolating and enhancing these objects from live video feeds.
